Probes: 'get out of the house' 0.66, 'slice and serve' 0.55, 'let cool' 0.32, 'be prepared, because' 0.36; but a narrative 'was out of the house' also scored 0.33, and six other imperative instructions (leave the building, stir/pour/bake, stay calm, keep the wound clean) scored under 0.10.
